description: Loader/skeleton consistency across screens + robust static-page open with retry. Replace bare <Loading/> spinners with Shimmer skeletons modeled on OrdersSkeleton, seed admin order-detail from cache so it opens instantly, add a home error/retry affordance, lighten the cart loading, and add a Retry button to the CMS page error state. UI-only: do NOT change data fetching/caching logic. Covers plan.md items 4,5,6,7,8,9. Depends on FEAT-001 ordering-wise (shares nothing functionally, but both edit app/admin/order/[id].tsx, so run after FEAT-001 to avoid a merge seam in that file).
steps: src/components/ui.tsx: add and export a shared OrdersSkeleton component (Shimmer card rows) lifted from app/(tabs)/orders.tsx so both the tab and admin screens use one source of truth. Keep it lightweight (Shimmer only).
app/(tabs)/orders.tsx: import OrdersSkeleton from src/components/ui.tsx and remove the local copy; behavior unchanged (skeleton only on first-ever load: q.isLoading && !orders.length).

app/admin/orders.tsx: replace the staff-guard <Loading/> and the body <Loading text='Loading orders...'/> with <OrdersSkeleton/> (body skeleton shown on first load isLoading && !orders.length). Keep the push-permission card, pending banner, search, and poll unchanged.

app/admin/order/[id].tsx: add a local OrderDetailSkeleton() (Shimmer mirroring the customer, items, and status cards). Replace the full-screen <Loading/> (while staff && q.isLoading) with <OrderDetailSkeleton/> (keep the !staff quick-return). Cache-first seed: read qc.getQueryData<Order>(['order', id]) and the matching entry in qc.getQueryData(['all-orders']); if present, display it immediately (via useOrder placeholderData/initialData in src/queries.ts OR by rendering the cached order while q.isLoading) so detail opens instantly. KEEP setStatus EXACTLY as-is and KEEP the screenshot card's own ActivityIndicator (do not alter the useScreenshot timeout added in FEAT-001).

app/product/[id].tsx: add a local ProductDetailSkeleton() (Shimmer: ~280px image block in a Card, then title/price/3 description bars). Replace `if (q.isLoading) return <Screen...><Loading/></Screen>` with the skeleton; cold cache shows the skeleton, not a spinner. Keep the !product EmptyState and all zoom/rotate/cart logic.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx: replace the categories <Loading/> with a horizontal category-rail Shimmer (~6 chips ~84px wide, matching s.cat); replace the popular-products <Loading/> with the existing ProductGridSkeleton (cardWidth=cardW). Add a small error/retry affordance (text + GradientButton size 'sm' 'Retry / दोबारा' calling queryClient.invalidateQueries()) shown when categoriesQ.isError||productsQ.isError with empty data, instead of silently empty. Keep hero/ads/banner logic and cache-first behavior unchanged. Remove the Loading import if it becomes unused.

app/(tabs)/cart.tsx: remove the `if (productsQ.isLoading && items.length) return <...><Loading/></...>` full-screen spinner; render cart rows immediately from local items. Optionally show a tiny Shimmer only in the per-row image slot while productsQ.isLoading. Confirm cartTotals degrades gracefully with an empty products array.

app/page/[slug].tsx: in the error branch `(isError && !page)` render an EmptyState whose action is a GradientButton 'Retry / दोबारा कोशिश करें' that calls the query's refetch (destructure refetch from usePage(slug)). Keep PageSkeleton only for isLoading && !page. Do NOT touch the WebView source/originWhitelist/onShouldStartLoadWithRequest (proven working). Keep bilingual copy.
acceptance_criteria: cd 4astore-v2/mobile; npx tsc --noEmit prints ONLY the known app.config.ts(39) usesCleartextTraffic error.

No bare full-screen <Loading/> remains on first load in: admin/order/[id].tsx, product/[id].tsx, admin/orders.tsx, (tabs)/index.tsx (categories+popular), (tabs)/cart.tsx — each shows a Shimmer skeleton or renders rows directly.
OrdersSkeleton is a single shared component in src/components/ui.tsx used by both (tabs)/orders.tsx and admin/orders.tsx.
admin/order/[id].tsx opens instantly from ['order',id]/['all-orders'] cache when present; setStatus is byte-for-byte unchanged; the screenshot card keeps its own indicator.
home shows a Retry affordance on error instead of silent empty; cart renders without waiting on useProducts.
page/[slug].tsx error state has a working Retry button calling refetch; the WebView block is unchanged.
verification: cd c:/xampp/htdocs/static4a/.worktrees/app-slow-loaders-login/4astore-v2/mobile; npm install; npx tsc --noEmit  (expect ONLY the app.config.ts usesCleartextTraffic error)
Read each edited screen and confirm the skeleton/retry changes and that data-fetching/caching logic (query keys, intervals) is unchanged.
Confirm setStatus in admin/order/[id].tsx is unchanged and the WebView in page/[slug].tsx is unchanged.
findings:
DONE. Verified: `npm install` then `npx tsc --noEmit` in 4astore-v2/mobile prints ONLY the known app.config.ts(39) TS2353 usesCleartextTraffic error (no new errors). UI-only changes; no data-fetching/caching logic (query keys, intervals) touched; no new npm dependency added.

SHARED OrdersSkeleton LOCATION: now exported from src/components/ui.tsx as `export function OrdersSkeleton({ count = 3 }: { count?: number })` (Card+Shimmer rows, lifted verbatim from the old (tabs)/orders.tsx local copy; uses the module-local `styles.divider`). Both app/(tabs)/orders.tsx and app/admin/orders.tsx now import it from '../../src/components/ui' (local copy removed from the orders tab). Any later screen needing an orders-list skeleton should import this one.

PER-SCREEN CHANGES:
- app/(tabs)/orders.tsx: removed local OrdersSkeleton, imports shared one; render condition unchanged (q.isLoading && !orders.length).
- app/admin/orders.tsx: staff-guard <Loading/> -> <OrdersSkeleton/>; body `isLoading ? <Loading text='Loading orders...'/>` -> `isLoading && !orders.length ? <OrdersSkeleton/>` (first-load only). Push-permission card, pending banner, search, 7s poll unchanged.
- app/admin/order/[id].tsx: added local OrderDetailSkeleton() (3 Shimmer cards: customer/items/status). Replaced the full-screen <Loading/> with cache-first logic: `cachedOrder = qc.getQueryData<Order>(['order',id]) ?? (qc.getQueryData<Order[]>(['all-orders'])||[]).find(x=>x.order_id===String(id))`; `resolved = q.data ?? cachedOrder`; render skeleton while !resolved, error card only when (isError||!q.data) && !resolved, else `const o = resolved`. IMPORTANT for later editors: `o` is derived via `const o = resolved` AFTER an `if (!resolved) return` guard so TS narrows `o` to Order for the setStatus closure — do NOT revert to `const o = q.data` or you reintroduce the possibly-undefined errors. setStatus() is byte-for-byte unchanged. The screenshot card's own ActivityIndicator and the FEAT-001 useScreenshot 15s AbortController timeout are untouched. Removed the now-unused `Loading` import; added `Shimmer`.
- app/product/[id].tsx: added ProductDetailSkeleton() (280px image Shimmer in a Card + title/price/3 desc bars + button bar); `if (q.isLoading) return <ProductDetailSkeleton/>`. !product EmptyState and all zoom/rotate/cart logic unchanged. Swapped `Loading` import for `Shimmer`.
- app/(tabs)/index.tsx: categories <Loading/> -> horizontal rail of 6 Shimmer chips sized like s.cat; popular <Loading/> -> <ProductGridSkeleton cardWidth={cardW}/>; added an error/retry row (text 'Load nahi hua / Couldn’t load' + GradientButton size 'sm' 'Retry / दोबारा' -> queryClient.invalidateQueries()) shown only when (categoriesQ.isError||productsQ.isError) && not loading && empty data. Hero/ads/banner/cache-first logic unchanged. Replaced `Loading` import with `ProductGridSkeleton, Shimmer`.
- app/(tabs)/cart.tsx: removed the `if (productsQ.isLoading && items.length) return <...><Loading/>` full-screen early return; cart rows render immediately from local `items`. Confirmed cartTotals (src/checkout.ts) degrades with an empty products array (byId lookup falls back to item fields). Removed unused `Loading` import.
- app/page/[slug].tsx: error branch `(isError && !page) || !page` EmptyState now has `action={<GradientButton title='Retry / दोबारा कोशिश करें' onPress={()=>refetch()}/>}` (destructured `refetch` from usePage). PageSkeleton still only for isLoading && !page. The WebView source/originWhitelist/onShouldStartLoadWithRequest block is UNTOUCHED. Added GradientButton import.

NOTE: grep/file-search tools resolve against the PARENT workspace, not this worktree, so verification of worktree files was done via direct reads + tsc, which is the authoritative gate here.
